name: arrowescape
description: ArrowEscape: Path Puzzle - Minimalist Snake Arrow Escape Game for Android and iOS

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('www')) fs.mkdirSync('www'); if(!fs.existsSync('www/js')) fs.mkdirSync('www/js'); ['index.html', 'manifest.json', 'sw.js', 'style.css'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/' + f)); ['audio.js', 'solver.js', 'levels.js', 'game.js'].forEach(f => fs.copyFileSync('js/' + f, 'www/js/' + f));"

author: GamerStudio LLC
